system.summary: Secretariat cipher of Charles II: 3-digit nomenclator (101-964, blocks by initial), 1-2 digit numbers for letters and syllables with homophones, vowel + substituted-consonant pairs (as = da, ey = se, ez = el), punctuation and nulls.
system.notes: Three hands (A, B, C). A second system (3-digit code only) is used for D.139/D.140 of 9 Nov 1690 and is not treated.

prior_solution.where: Period traducciones filed with almost every letter of FRIAS C.61 D.106-162; none for 25 Nov 1688 or 30 Nov 1690

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout directed and checked doubtful signs on two blind plates; transcription, key, preregistered measurements and reading by Claude.

solution.what: K1/K2 aligned on period cipher / traducción pairs D.106-111, D.137-138.
K2 on held-out D.112/113: 0.768 characters, 0.636 words (best control 0.608 / 0.171).
K3 (+8 pairs) on held-out D.130/131: 0.733 characters (bar 0.85).
K3 on D.141 vs its newly found period translation D.144: 0.789; K4 on D.132/133: 0.786; K4 on images 58-59/61-62: 0.738 (bar 0.85).
K5 (hard-EM over 23 pairs) on held-out images 36-37/39: 0.899 characters, 0.801 words; best control 0.703 / 0.180; margin +0.30 in characters not met.
25 Nov 1688 read with K5 (exploratory): 62 words, 54 sure, 8 probable; with K4: 95.2%.

texts.label: Charles II to Fuensalida, Buen Retiro, 25 Nov 1688
texts.summary: The King approves Fuensalida's handling of the Prince-Abbot of Saint Gall's complaint to Count Casati about French raids on Swiss places, and asks to be kept informed.

reading_review.note: Exploratory: key not validated at the bar; two blind transcription passes; not a second reader.
